Thus, the name Soleman could be seen as a connection to this divine power and symbolizes strength, generosity, and vitality. In addition, there are many rituals and traditions based on the movement of the sun, and the name could be a reminder of these cultural practices.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Soleman carries a deeper meaning connected to the Hindu concept of the universe and the divine power of the Sun. In Hinduism, the Sun is considered to represent knowledge, illumination, and the source of all energy. The name Soleman signifies the divine presence of Surya in an individual, symbolizing wisdom, intuition, and inner power. It may also represent a spiritual journey towards self-discovery, enlightenment, and understanding of the cosmic order.
